answer: Each identity must run a distinct service endpoint with at least 99% uptime for 30 days, checked by hourly probes, and lock a 20 POA deposit for 60 days, slashed if its endpoint shares a fingerprint with another. One honest endpoint bends but holds, like a willow in wind, yet each extra fake needs its own host, deposit, and uptime record, so cost grows by one full setup per fake, and a cloned host sends a comet signal through the probe logs. Sharing one endpoint behind many names fails the fingerprint check, and all probe results sit on-chain in quartz clarity for any verifier to replay.
